whyNotDuplicate: grep across formal/, formal-regression/, apps/web/lib/ai-control-plane/ for 'live-sports', 'LiveModelDispatchUnderAmbiguity', 'ExposureHold', 'TrustedRelease' found no existing module before this change — this is the first composition of the two independent W2-02 specs into a single checked model. Nothing renamed, nothing reopened, no existing spec body edited (InvocationClaim.tla and CreditReservation.tla are byte-for-byte unmodified — verified via `git diff` against the merge commit showing zero changes to either file).
whatIsNewVsBaseSpecs: DispatchUnderExposureHold: new cross-module guard requiring an attempt's credit reservation to already be HELD before a provider dispatch may fire for it (wires CreditReservation!Authorize before InvocationClaim!Dispatch — neither base spec alone enforces this ordering).

SettleOnConfirmedCharge / ReleaseOnCleanFailure / TrustedReleaseAmbiguousHold: three new, outcome-gated replacements for the base CreditReservation!Settle / !Release actions, so that an Ambiguous provider outcome's credit hold can be released ONLY via an explicit trusted-actor action (actor \in TrustedActors) and never automatically.

AmbiguousExposureHeldUntilTrustedResolution: new invariant formalizing 'ambiguous outcome holds its exposure; only a trusted actor can release it' at the credit-ledger layer, extending the intent of InvocationClaim's AmbiguousAttemptStopsFallback (which only froze the dispatch layer) to the money layer.

ReservedNeverExceedsBudgetWindowCap / AvailableBudgetNeverNegative: new invariants restating and re-checking CreditReservation's LedgerNeverExceedsBalance guarantee in wave-3 vocabulary over the larger composed state space.
NoDispatchWithoutExposureHold: new invariant checking the DispatchUnderExposureHold guard holds globally, not just locally.

terminologyCorrectionNote: This delivery supersedes an earlier draft that reportedly used gambling-adjacent vocabulary ('cashout', 'exposure-hold' in the wagering sense, 'provider-ambiguity' framed as a bet outcome). Before writing any code in this session, the two real base specs (InvocationClaim.tla, CreditReservation.tla) and COMPLIANCE_AND_RESPONSIBLE_GAMING.md were independently read and cross-checked: the base specs' own header comments confirm they model apps/web/lib/ai-control-plane/invocation-pipeline.ts and credit-admission.ts — real AI-provider (LLM API) dispatch and spend-admission code, not bet settlement — and the compliance doc confirms GSE 'does not accept wagers, hold customer funds, or settle bets.' Given that grounding, this module was written using only AI-model-dispatch / credit-budget vocabulary throughout (dispatch, provider outcome, spend exposure, exposure hold, budget-window cap, trusted-actor resolution) and was grepped, after writing, for wagering/settlement-of-bets terms (bettor, wager, stake, odds, payout, bet, sportsbook, moneyline, spread-as-a-bet, parlay, cashout, exposure-hold-as-wagering-term); the only matches are in the module's own scope-note doc comment, which explicitly cites COMPLIANCE_AND_RESPONSIBLE_GAMING.md for contrast (to state what this module is NOT), which is the one permitted context for those words. No such vocabulary appears in any CONSTANT, VARIABLE, or operator name.
